items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025

ctx.x: I have a piece of Benny Goodman memorabilia I thought I would share with you. This is from The Tonight Show —

Yes. Skitch Henderson and Benny was the guest, and for some reason he requested Marian McPartland to play, and you’ve got the trumpet section in the back with Clark Terry and Snooky Young, Doc Severinsen, and Bob Rosengarden is the drummer and he’s the one that gave us this photo.
